Package me.qscbm.inlayx.drop

Class DropSourceRegistry

java.lang.Object
me.qscbm.inlayx.drop.DropSourceRegistry
public final class DropSourceRegistry extends Object
掉落来源注册表.

注册表只负责保存来源, 注册顺序和默认设置, 不负责匹配与掉落判定.
